name: Example 1
input: three bills, then mark B-105 paid
test:
from datetime import date
tracker = BillStatusTracker()
tracker.add_bill('B-104', 1250, date(2025, 8, 20))
tracker.add_bill('B-105', 760, date(2025, 8, 12))
tracker.add_bill('B-106', 300, date(2025, 8, 29))
tracker.update_payment_status('B-105', PaymentStatus.PAID)
assert tracker.get_unpaid_bills() == [
    {'bill_id': 'B-104', 'amount_cents': 1250, 'due_date': date(2025, 8, 20), 'status': PaymentStatus.UNPAID},
    {'bill_id': 'B-106', 'amount_cents': 300, 'due_date': date(2025, 8, 29), 'status': PaymentStatus.UNPAID},
]
